summary: Tested master-admin bulk Suspend/Restore access/Delete/Restore on /contacts, the suspended-provider screen, the erase cron, and the Network page merged into Activities. Backend: 27 pytest cases in test_user_admin_bulk.py; 26 pass, 1 fails (deleted users can still log in). Also 1 cron end-to-end test that erased probe B, passing. Frontend: all requested flows pass after one backend bug fix (below). Every probe or sample row was suspended or archived and then restored, and all were cleaned up afterwards.

critical.issue: FIXED by testing agent. The self-skip check `c.supabase_user_id == current.supabase_user_id` was None == None for the master admin (who has no supabase_user_id), so every Mongo-only contact (leads/prospects) was skipped with the toast 'N skipped (master admin)'. Those contacts could never be suspended or deleted. The check is now guarded with `current.get('supabase_user_id') and ...`. Retested: works.

minor.issue: A deleted (archived) user can complete the full phone -> OTP -> password login and is issued an access token. Every later call returns 401 'This account has been deleted', so in the UI the user is silently sent back to /login with no message. Reject at verify-otp/login-password when crm_users.disabled or the contact is archived, with a clear message such as 'This account was deleted. Contact Trata to restore it.'
days_left uses floor (`.days`), so a user deleted just now shows '29 days' instead of 30. Use ceil.

Works: probe B's contact and crm_user were removed, and the Supabase row was anonymised to 'Deleted user' / phone 'del-<id>' because of an FK from emergency_cases. Anonymised rows keep is_archived=TRUE forever, and test fixture cleanup (by phone) can no longer find them. An older anonymised row ba59ae87-6d85-4e6e-ad41-95d26d79a506 (probably from E1's manual check) is still in the shared Supabase. Please check it and remove it if it is a probe.

Supabase users.is_suspended is written but never read back. A suspension set by the Provider/TrataX teams, or a crm_user re-materialised from the Supabase fallback, will not be blocked in the CRM. Consider checking is_suspended in the Supabase fallback login and sync.

integration_issues.issue: After the password step, the user is sent back to /login with no error or toast (see backend minor issue).

issues: The skip toast always says 'skipped (master admin)', even when the reason is 'yourself'. Use the reason returned in `skipped[].why`.
The overline still reads 'LIVE OPERATIONS' and the heading reads 'Activities', while the sidebar says 'My Activity Log'. Cosmetic.
The type tabs and search are hidden, so large archived lists cannot be filtered. Minor.

action_items: Block deleted/archived users at verify-otp/login-password with a clear error message
Show the real skip reason in the bulk toast
Optional: read Supabase is_suspended back when materialising or syncing crm_users
Check the anonymised Supabase row ba59ae87-... and delete it if it is a test probe
critical_code_review_comments: user_admin.bulk: the self-skip None==None bug (fixed). Prefer comparing current['id'] to the crm_user linked to the contact.
server._block_if_suspended raises 401 for disabled users, but the login endpoints never check disabled, so tokens are still issued.
Contacts.jsx fetch() has no try/catch: an API error leaves loading=true forever.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows after the fix

seed_data_creation: Temporary Mongo-only contacts 'Zeta QA Sample One/Two' (deleted). Probe fixtures were set up and cleaned twice. Probe B was erased by the cron, and its anonymised Supabase row was deleted manually.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `python ledger_probe_fixtures.py setup` before test_user_admin_bulk.py; its module teardown restores and unsuspends. test_user_admin_erase_cron.py DESTROYS probe B: run it only when no other archived contacts exist (it has a guard), and afterwards delete the 'del-<uid>' Supabase row by id. UI login can be skipped by setting localStorage trata_token/trata_user. Probe names are hidden in /contacts, so use Mongo-only sample contacts for bulk-bar UI tests. The Admin App REST source is unreachable in preview (external).
